map.重点核对通用名而非商品名：许多复方感冒药、止痛药都含对乙酰氨基酚，商品名各异但成: Focus on checking generic names rather than brand names: many compound cold medicines and painkillers contain acetaminophen, with varied brand names but overlapping ingredients, and simultaneous use can unknowingly exceed the 4 g/day ceiling and cause liver damage.
